title: Navier sinusoidal composite plate on a Winkler foundation
source: Bert and Siu NASA CR-112140 (1972), Navier FSDT system as derived in composite-navier-static-thick/README; Winkler term adds k to the transverse diagonal (Hetenyi 1946). W=1/(1/W0+k), W0=1.1636747564990154e-9 m, q=1 Pa, k=1e8 N/m³.

quantities.reason: Same predeclared 3% 8x8 MITC4 discretization band as the parent Navier FSDT case; foundation stiffness included through consistent surface integration.
